description: Agent Hiring: submit a candidate’s rate quote with the brief and the budget it set: the quote with the candidate, its date, the currency, the rate, the unit (hour, task or project), each priced line with the brief scope item it prices, its quantity in hours or tasks and its amount, and the total; the brief with the currency, the budget, the unit the budget is set in and each scope item it asks to be priced. The signed report gives the quote and the brief, each scope item matched to its priced line, each hourly or per-task line recomputed as its quantity times the rate, the total recomputed from the lines, and the total or the rate against the budget, and counts them, and names a divergent quote: a scope item the quote leaves unpriced, a line amount unlike its quantity times the rate, a total unlike its lines, and a quote above the budget; then a rate in another unit than a budget set per hour or per task and a line the brief does not ask for, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No scope items, no budget, no total or rate to read against it, or a line with no quantity leaves the quote unverified. A project budget reads against the quote’s total, and a budget per hour or per task against the rate in the same unit; amounts compare to the cent. This reads one candidate’s rate quote against the brief that set the budget: wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads a negotiation mandate’s limits and authority, and wever_negotiation-terms-check reads a proposed deal’s price basis, deliverables and payment triggers, for Agent Negotiation, and wever_quote-compare compares two to twenty provider quotes for the same job, while the rate check recomputes each priced line and the total against the brief’s scope and budget. Verdict hire_rate_divergent, hire_rate_partial, hire_rate_unverified or hire_rate_consistent. POST /api/hire-rate-check. Reads the hiring paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no judgment of whether a candidate is good, qualified in substance or worth hiring, no background check, no contact with referees or issuers, no verification with outside sources and no employment-law advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Hiring reads supplied hiring paperwork for consistency between documents: a hiring brief, a credential record, a portfolio or past-work record, a reference, a rate quote, an engagement contract, an availability commitment and a payment setup. Beside it, wever_post-job, wever_accept-job and the other tools of the intent job kit are the execution layer that posts, accepts and settles jobs, and wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork before anything is committed; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-hiring-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-hiring/.
